name: mightling
description: Mightling local delegation plugin for Claude Code (the model-free tools watch, lookup, run_test, git_log and diff_stat, and the task tool that hands bounded edits with one test to the local model, on probation).

node.title: Mightling node
node.description: Optional Mightling node name or id (the host of the model server for task; empty means this machine).

max_parallel.title: Maximum parallel tasks
max_parallel.description: Maximum concurrent delegated tasks (default 2; the limit on running task calls).

allow_classes.title: Enabled delegation classes
allow_classes.description: Comma-separated enabled delegation classes: the model-free W1 and L1 (watch, lookup, run_test, git_log, diff_stat), and task (T1 to T5, on probation) or a class code such as T2.
